game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Crypt Stairs, stairs to a crypt: the ruin warden must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Mutation Mystery: Spot when two names point to the same list and when copy() is needed.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Crypt Stairs: stairs to a crypt
core_gameplay_loop: In Crypt Stairs, repeat each round: Spot when two names point to the same list and when copy() is needed. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the mutation_safe value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the heart stone using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The heart stone reached with actions_used <= 17.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the heart stone is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 6 (applied tier): Mutation Mystery
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mutation Mystery' (Week 7 slot 15), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Crypt Stairs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how mutation_safe changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ghost knights in Crypt Stairs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The heart stone reached with actions_used <= 17.
